output.title: Cozy Renovated Studio with Historic Character in Clausen
output.description:
Nestled in the atmospheric Clausen valley, this exquisitely renovated studio exemplifies a harmonious blend of historic charm and contemporary living. The inviting main room features striking exposed beams and elegant hardwood flooring, creating a warm and character-rich ambiance that welcomes both comfort and style.

Thoughtfully designed for efficient living, the compact kitchenette is equipped with modern amenities, including a two-burner cooktop and stainless steel sink, perfectly suited for culinary endeavors. Adjacent, the renovated bathroom boasts clean lines and pristine tiling, adding a fresh and refined touch to the residence.

Situated within a meticulously maintained historic stone building, this fully furnished studio commands a prime location mere steps from Luxembourg's vibrant city center, yet retains the quiet allure distinctive to Clausen. This property offers an exceptional opportunity for those seeking a blend of heritage and modern convenience in one of the city's most coveted neighborhoods.

The building's longstanding appeal is underpinned by a history of reliable tenancy, fostering a welcoming community atmosphere. Prospective investors benefit from a guaranteed rental yield of 8% annually, attesting to both the demand and stability this unique property provides.
